prompts.name: format
prompts.prompt: List the first 10 prime numbers on one line, separated by commas with no spaces. Output nothing else.

prompts.name: clock
prompts.prompt: A clock shows 3:15. What is the smaller angle between the hour and minute hands, in degrees? End with a line in exactly this form, where N is the number: Answer: N

prompts.name: count
prompts.prompt: How many integers from 1 to 1000 are divisible by 3 or 5, but not by 15? End with a line in exactly this form, where N is the number: Answer: N

prompts.name: essay
prompts.prompt: Explain TCP congestion control in about 1200 words. Use exactly these three headings, each on its own line: ## Slow start, ## Congestion avoidance, ## Fast recovery. Plain Markdown only.

prompts.name: primes-code
prompts.prompt: Write primes.py in the current folder. It must print how many prime numbers are below 100000. Run it. End your reply with a line in exactly this form, digits only with no commas: Count: N
